name: run-it
title: Run It Yourself
html:
Run It Yourself

sh exhibits/merge-watch-release/hal-forms/run.sh          # walk once in HAL-FORMS, keep, replay five
sh exhibits/merge-watch-release/hal-forms/run.sh replay   # replay five, no model
RELEASE_RUNG=L2 sh exhibits/merge-watch-release/variants.sh OUT   # the HAL Schema Forms script, at L2
sh exhibits/two-dialects/build.sh                        # this deck

Needs Docker for Jenkins, and a model key for the walk only.
say: Three commands. The first walks the goal once with Claude in HAL-FORMS, keeps the script, and replays the five. The second replays only, with no model. The third replays the HAL Schema Forms script, at L0 or, with RELEASE_RUNG, at L2.
